title: Patient Account Collector - Fertility Claims  26-00195
description:
Position
Patient Account Collector
Fertility Claims 

About our Client 
Our client is one of Southern California’s leading fertility centers, providing compassionate, state-of-the-art reproductive care for over 35 years. With multiple locations across Los Angeles, Orange County, and the Inland Empire, their board-certified physicians and clinical teams have helped thousands of individuals and couples build families through personalized treatment and advanced technology. Committed to innovation, inclusivity, and patient-centered care, our client remains a trusted leader in reproductive medicine and family-building care.

Position Overview
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced patient account/self-pay collector to join our client's team. Your primary responsibility will be to follow up on unpaid patient fertility claim balances, ensuring a high level of patient-customer service throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide excellent patient-customer service.
  • Make outbound calls to patients to collect open balances.
  • Notify customers with high balances and mail past-due notices.
  • Review and reconcile patient ledger and balances.
  • Follow up on the status of payments.
  • Itemize and print courtesy statements for patients.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum one-year billing and/or collections experience
  • Fertility A/R experience is highly preferred but not required.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Knowledge of soft collection techniques.
  • Compassionate, understanding, and patient-centric approach.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel preferred.
  • Data entry skills and typing speed of 40 wpm.
  • High School diploma or equivalent.

Benefits

  • Free Healthcare 
  • Free Fertility Services 
  • (15) Days PTO that grows based on Tenure 
  • (7) Paid Holidays 
  • 401(k)
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program

Additional Information

Full-Time, On-Site | Pasadena, CA 
Direct Placement

title: Inside Sales Agent-Healthcare Call Center  26-00194
description:
Inside Sales - Healthcare Call Center Agent
Location: Aliso Viejo
Category: Sales
Position Type: Regular Full-Time, Direct Placement
Work Arrangement: On-site with potential for Hybrid
Compensation: Up to $25/hr (CWE) + Additional Bonus Incentive 

Overview
Our client is one of the largest ophthalmology providers in the U.S., with over ninety centers across six states including California, Oregon, Arizona, Texas, and Utah. An innovative leader in ophthalmology, they deliver an exceptional patient experience through advanced technology and a team of highly skilled, experienced surgeons — trusted by more than 3,000 referring eye doctors nationwide.

We're looking for a high energy, people focused Inside Sales Call Center Agent who excels at building trust, influencing decisions, and guiding patients toward life-changing vision correction procedures. This role is ideal for someone who loves connecting with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and knows how to turn meaningful conversations into scheduled appointments.

You'll serve as the first impression for prospective patients, many of whom are referred directly by their optometrist and already considering a procedure — educating, supporting, and motivating them to take the next step in their vision journey. The right candidate is persuasive without being pushy, empathetic without losing focus, and confident in leading consultative sales conversations from first inquiry to booked consultation. This role comes with incentive compensation tied to performance, so the more patients you help get booked, the more you earn.
​
This is an on-site position with structured training to set you up for success from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Engage prospective patients with enthusiasm, confidence, and professionalism from the very first call.
  • Convert inbound inquiries into scheduled consultations through consultative conversation and relationship building.
  • Educate patients on procedures, financing options, and the overall patient experience in a clear, compelling way.
  • Overcome objections and help hesitant callers feel confident moving forward.
  • Deliver a concierge-level experience that exceeds expectations.
  • Make outbound follow-up calls to reengage prospective patients and maximize conversions.
  • Build trust while representing the surgeons and clinical teams with professionalism.
  • Use empathy and sound judgment when assisting anxious or upset callers.
  • Accurately schedule appointments across multiple clinic locations, each with its own surgeons, procedures, and scheduling preferences.
  • Collaborate with clinic teams to support patient retention and satisfaction.
  • Maintain strong product knowledge and stay informed on offerings and processes.
  • Meet and exceed performance metrics related to conversion, booking, and patient satisfaction.
  • Bring warmth and personality to every conversation — small, genuine touches (using a patient's name, a kind word about their upcoming appointment) make all the difference in how patients experience that first call.
Qualifications
  • 2+ years of sales or customer engagement experience (inside sales, retail, real estate, appointment setting, hospitality, collections, or similar). Backgrounds in collections, tax service call centers, or high-end retail tend to translate especially well to this role.
  • Experience in dental or aesthetics/elective procedures (such as Botox or injectables) is a strong plus — these fields share a similar consultative, sales-driven patient conversation.
  • Proven ability to influence conversations and convert opportunities into appointments or sales.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills with confidence and professionalism.
  • Competitive, goal-oriented mindset with a strong work ethic.
  • Ability to multitask and perform in a fast-paced, corporate call center environment.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and ability to connect quickly.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus; Vietnamese or Farsi is also a plus.
  • Looking for someone who wants to build a career — many call center team members grow into patient-facing roles after a year or two.

title: Call Center Agent-Healthcare (CSR)   26-00193
description:
Call Center Agent (CSR)
Job Location: Aliso Viejo, CA
Position Type: Regular Full-Time, Direct Placement
Work Location: On-site with potential for Hybrid

Overview
Our client is one of the largest ophthalmology providers in the U.S., with over ninety centers across six states including California, Oregon, Arizona, Texas, and Utah. An innovative leader in ophthalmology, they deliver an exceptional patient experience through advanced technology and a team of highly skilled, experienced surgeons—trusted by more than 3,000 referring eye doctors nationwide.

We are seeking a call center agent to join the team! This position is responsible for ensuring the consistent delivery of a great patient experience that exceeds the expectations of our callers and our clinic locations. This role will ensure company success by raising conversion rates from initial phone call to consultation, as well as the handling of all other call types with empathy and a patient-centric focus.

You'll support patients across the organization's many locations nationwide, helping with everything from scheduling and rescheduling to prescription questions, post-procedure guidance, and connecting patients to the right level of care quickly and confidently.

This is an on-site position with structured training to set you up for success from day one.

Responsibilities
  • Answer telephone promptly in a polite and professional manner and exceed patient satisfaction. 
  • Able to answer questions succinctly and professionally and evaluate when to escalate.  
  • Ensure patients are booked for consultation during their first call to NVISION.  
  • Presents in a professional and educated manner to all customers, patients, and Dr.'s  that call in.  
  • Place outbound calls timely and with enthusiasm to assist  
  • Research and resolve issues to ensure patient retention and satisfaction.  
  • Use sound judgment and empathy in handling calls, especially with upset patients.  
  • Schedule appointments correctly—servicing multiple centers.  
  • Maintains knowledge of company products and customer service processes  
  • Ability to handle a call center environment: work quickly and multitask.  
Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a high-volume call center preferred but willing to train the right person. Backgrounds in collections, tax service call centers, or high-end retail tend to translate especially well to this role.
  • Ophthalmology, dental, or aesthetics/elective procedure experience would be helpful but not required.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, performance-coached, corporate call center environment.
  • Looking for someone who wants to build a career — many call center team members grow into patient-facing roles after a year or two.
  • Bilingual is a plus (English/Spanish); Vietnamese or Farsi is also a plus.
Why You'll Love It Here
  • Performance-based bonus incentives
  • Comprehensive, competitive benefits package
  • Real opportunities for internal growth and advancement
